scope: Read-only review of the frozen smoke4 candidate's predecessor diagnosis, source and registry identity, slug preflight, child environment handoff, and scientific-source invariance. No Kaggle push or provider mutation was performed.

candidate.packet_sha256_scope: SHA-256 of smoke4.packet.json; it binds the exact kernel, metadata, offline receipt, tests, source input identities, and frozen run-spec hashes.

checks.name: smoke3 failure diagnosis
checks.evidence: The bound smoke3 terminal receipt (SHA-256 f9934d493eebcc7f8e6250425be6cd27bd94769741213c766f5a924eed25780f) records both fit children failing in load_campaign_split with 'campaign source changed: .../cache/chain_folds.npz'; prediction and grade were blocked. The recorded failure was before training, with no prediction, grade, or scientific-result claim. The split source's bytes are content-addressed, but its mounted mtime differs, and smoke3 did not pass WNN_PORTABLE_DATA_MANIFEST to child commands.

checks.name: exact source and registry bindings
checks.evidence: Candidate references match the producer artifacts: source-v2 assets manifest 96fa0dcbd2c0a56f8ef9d23620080337799022290ffee87196d52de58aca4f70; source archive 2d64aaf9b3f416db460e41684def3b511462283aec588bc94f536b8db1f66930; fold0 assets manifest 19fe0eb6445553c2adff00e821a4fa16ca5969473ca8be420c32cb8e4b4b72c7; portable registry 90d26c7063050092eeda774c7c6298897a8fb133e4804ac13d0a281bd328ff8c. The fold0 manifest contains the portable registry at the stated path and hash. The smoke3 terminal-receipt and packet hashes in the candidate match the actual predecessor files.

checks.name: portable registry verification and worker handoff
checks.evidence: Before queue creation or worker startup, mount_manifests accepts only the two reviewed dataset manifest hashes, verifies each manifest and staged-file size, hashes files at or below 50 MiB, rejects duplicate mounted dataset/path identities, and requires both datasets. bind_portable_registry then checks the registry file SHA-256, rejects a conflicting preexisting step environment value, and assigns WNN_PORTABLE_DATA_MANIFEST to each of the six child steps. write_queues serializes those mutated specs. The exact source archive's warm_queue_worker.py overlays step.env on its inherited process environment before launching argv, so both fit and prediction receive the bound registry path. The exact source archive's splits.py consumes the variable in load_campaign_split and checks each source against the registry.

checks.name: prediction-consumer nuance
checks.evidence: The variable is injected into the prediction child environment, but the frozen predict_run.py does not itself read WNN_PORTABLE_DATA_MANIFEST or call load_campaign_split; it obtains row groups from cache/<split>_targets.npz. Thus the repair fixes the observed fit-loader failure and supplies the requested environment to prediction, but the registry is not an active prediction-side split validator in this source revision.
